Reasoning: Alfonso pulled his head out at 8:15 a.m. on Monday, and had already been underground for 98 hours 56 minutes. According to the method, decompose 98 hours 56 minutes into 4 days plus 2 hours 56 minutes, because 4 days is 96 hours, and 98 hours 56 minutes = 96 hours + 2 hours 56 minutes. First count backward 4 days from 8:15 a.m. on Monday, obtaining 8:15 a.m. on Thursday. Then subtract 2 hours 56 minutes backward from 8:15 a.m. on Thursday: 8:15 minus 2 hours is 6:15, then minus 56 minutes is 5:19. So Alfonso buried his head in the sand at 5:19 a.m. on Thursday.
